content: Kamongo Dokome Isaraele Wambu Pipya Koo Kando Yulu Mende Pira

Kamongo dokome Isaraele wambu pipya makapala koo kandale lao pii lara doko selapape. O Kamongo, sipurapala embena renge palamo doko laa. Larene dokopa yuu kyau kuki andakepe dupwame pii larene doko sinyale.
Yuu kyau isa yuu dokona susa pyao sulu singi dupwa Kamongona pii laramo doko selapape. Kamongo dokome banya Isaraele wambu dupwa pipya koo kando lalana suu pilyamuli pyuo lara.
Kamongo dokome dopa letamo. Nambana wambu dupwa nambame nakama pipya apa pipu? Nambame apa pyuo nakama mona kendanyi pyambwapusi? Isingi langyalapape.
Nambame nakama Isipi piso minyuo epeyo. Nambame nakama kendemande yulu pyuo kareyaminyi kiiramo nyiyu. Nambame Mosesemoo Eronemoo Miriamemoo dusipame nakama lanyuo paramiŋi lao peeyakayo.

Nambana wambu dupwa nakama keta kiŋi Beleke yuu Moape range dokome mende piruna lao lao palyiyamopa Belame Beona ikinyingi dokome baa isingi apa lamaiyape lao suu pyalapa. Dee yuu taone Akasiya dokona piso pao yuu Gilikale panya penge kata dokona yulu mende piya kande doko nakama masalapapeko. Yulu dupwa suu pyapala nambame nakama keta apa pyuo lete nyelana mende piyu doko soo gisarami.
Kamongome Wambu Keta Yulu Pimili Lao Piso Silyamo Doko
Nambame Kamongo Anatu yake panda karengedoko lakandala pao dokopa aki bange minyuo pao mairusi? Nambame mena bulamakao ikyane ama keyange minyuo epo kiso mairusi?

Nambame mena sipisipi taosande malu minyuo epo maiyuo dee isa olipi ipwange ipwa ingyuo guu lao karalu karena lao soo kaeyo minyuo epo maiyuo piru ramo Kamongo dokome doko kando rae mairase? Dee nambana wane mupwasa doko nambana koo dupwana suu pyao nyuo kame sakana lao mairusi? Doko daa.

Kamongome keyange doko anjuku lao langipya kandapi. Dokona nakama keta yulu pimili lao suu pilyamo doko dakeŋe selapape. Yulu rolae yapasi dupwa pyuo nakamana mona retalu reto retenge doko lasaka pyuo nakamana Kamongo dokona inyimungu rape rape lao karo pirami.

Kamongo doko andake lao pakao kararami ramo doko mona palyuokondali pyuo kararamisa pira. Kamongome wambu yuu taone andake dokona palenge dupwa kando dopa lao kee letamo. Selapape. Nakama wambu yuu taone andake dokona elyambu pilyaminyi dupwa.

Akali yulu koo pingi dupwana anda dupwana kanape mee bange andakepe kyambo lao panga soo nyuo retelyaminyi. Nakama ropo pingi dokopa make angi dokona palya nao kana nyilyaminyi. Yulu dopale doko namba awa nange.
Akali dopa pyuo kopetame sikyali pyuo ropo pingi dupwa kapa nyuo kame sakamirase?
Nakamana akali numi dupwame wambu pendewa dupwana bange dupwa mee nyakamyuo kamame pendewa panyi nembo taonena palaminyi dupwa peparae pii kyambo lenge.
Dokona lao epapu nambame nakamana koo dupwana suu pyao nakama kanda soo pyao uki palyuo kokwa soo nembalana pyano.

Nakama nenge naraminyipape sikya pii napala mee yango nano nano piramo kararami. Nakamana pinji dupwa nyakarami lapala soo pelyamano lao paraminyipape kapa wai rombo nyii narami. Pinji lapo range nyuo parami dupwa nambame yanda pipala pyao kokwa sinya laro.

Nakama ee wara piraminyipape angi doko naa narami. Isa olipi ipwange kingyuo kamwaraminyipape range kapa mamba doko yanga narami. Dee waene ipwange kingyuo kamwaraminyipape angi doko kapa naa naramiko.

Nakamame kiŋi Omiripa banya ikinyingi kiŋi Ayapepa dolapona yulu koo dupwa moko minyuo pilyaminyi. Nakama nakambana pii leyambinyili pyuo kaeya nao pyuo puu pao pelyaminyi dokona nambame nakama pyao kokwa seronopa wambu menge yuu mure lao dupwa peparaeme nakama kilya kando gilya giyana pyuo lena lao piru.
